title: Malicious code in xssdoctor-muse-task448-provider-runtime (npm)
description: The npm package xssdoctor-muse-task448-provider-runtime version 1.0.0 contains malicious code that reads a file outside its own directory and sends its base64url-encoded contents to a hardcoded external endpoint controlled by the attacker. This behavior can lead to unintended data exfiltration if the package is resolved in place of a private internal package due to dependency confusion.
